text: You are viewed in a better light than most sector polities, although this has little in the way of implications.
You are considered an upstanding citizen of the Domain and your cooperation is appreciated.
Your continued efforts in furthering the Domain's goals in the sector has been noted by officials. Restricted hardware and information have been made available to access.

Although officially an independent asset, you have become an agent in all but name, and may enjoy the benefits of this position. You have been granted access to classified information and hardware many sector intelligence agencies would kill to possess.

The Domain of Man considers you an essential part of their plans for the sector's future should it be reconnected to civilisation. Your name has been noticed by high ranking Domain officials as a potential candidate for the post of sector governor.
You do not stand out in any particular way from the millions tracked by the Domain. Any dealings or movements will come under close scrutiny and port access is granted begrudgingly.
You have been tagged as a likely security risk and Domain officials will refuse to have any dealings with you. However they are willing to show leniency should you improve your standing.
Your IDENT-chip and all known associates have been flagged as insurgent. If historical records are to be believed, your life expectancy has significantly decreased.
